method.signature: 1024-bit grayscale difference hash (bilinear 33x32, horizontal gradient signs), also compared mirrored; 8-level-per-channel RGB histogram of a bilinear 64x48 thumbnail
method.automatic_rule: hash_bits <= 100 is near_duplicate unless a noted review overrides it
method.pairs_screened: TEST x calibration, TEST x all 1395 training images, calibration x training

decision_meanings.near_duplicate: Same photo (re-encoded, resized, recropped or mirrored) or an adjacent video frame.
decision_meanings.same_scene: Same clip or encounter at a different moment: same animal/vehicle/diver, site and light.
decision_meanings.different: Different photo; similar layout or water colour only.

method.limits: Every screened pair is decided, but the screen is a cut-off, not a complete search: counts.test_leak_bands shows how many leaked TEST images each lower colour band added, and same-clip frames below the gate very likely remain. SUIM has no video or session IDs, so scene-level independence is not established.
